USCGC Kanawha
navaid.description: USCGC Kanawha is a 75' river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Lower Mississippi River from mile 598 to mile 683, the Arkansas River from mile 0 to mile 71.2, and the White River from mile 0 to mile 10.3.
